syscalls.comment: Block namespace manipulation — primary container-escape vector

Block clone(CLONE_NEWUSER=0x10000000) — lets a process create a user namespace and remap uid 0, enabling privilege escalation even without CAP_SYS_ADMIN. SCMP_CMP_MASKED_EQ requires both value (mask) and valueTwo (comparison); without valueTwo it defaults to 0 and matches every fork. CLONE_THREAD, CLONE_VM etc. are unaffected so Python/Java threads still work.
Block kernel-level code execution and replacement
Block BPF — can be used to install kernel programs that filter or redirect syscalls
Block cross-process memory access and kernel introspection
Block perf_event_open — can leak kernel addresses and be used in side-channel attacks
Block userfaultfd — can be used to pause kernel execution for exploit primitives
Block kernel keyring — student code has no business touching key storage
Block kernel log and accounting access
